Question: What is wrong with instagram?
Answer: The people there, especially the creators, fool their stupid audience. Let's discuss this in detail in this post. After my post on a coding teacher yesterday, one of my followers shared her profile with me. I got excited looking at the ~$8K figure, which is the three-year salary of an average Indian man. I decided to research what she actually does. I watched 10–12 short videos of hers. In 3–4 videos, she was enjoying with her nibba, in another 3–4 videos, she was flexing her earnings, and in the remaining clips, she was just doing bullshit. I didn't get to know what she actually does; in every clip, she was saying that some client paid her $5k or this and that. In the USA, the average monthly salary is $4.2K, so ~$8k is a decent amount for them. Why would an American business pay an Indian girl for business consulting when she doesn't have an MBB tag or an MBA, and she doesn't understand US culture? Judging by her appearance, she looks to be no more than 22 or 24. US companies would obviously prefer consulting from someone who lives in the US to help them learn and improve their sales. How will an Indian girl help them? Also, a company would prefer getting consulting from an experienced person, not someone who is 22 or 24 years old. Hope you get my point. She is just fooling her followers by showing them these screenshots. Obviously, she got good genetics, which helps her in attracting simps. She never tells what she exactly does because she might not do anything. She just earns by selling some courses, not by freelancing or consulting. These types of people earn by creating content, nothing else. There are tons of people like her who share that they earn this much and that much from their company, and all of it is just nonsense. Rich people never flex their money; it's always the poor who do it. These people earn through these videos, nothing else. Just ignore such people and report their accounts. And most importantly, if they are earning this much, why are they creating these videos? Just go out and spend it, live your life. What's wrong with Instagram? Creators fooling their audience. That's it. Do share your opinion in comments. ~ Trying to live a life worth remembering

Question: If you had to write a letter to your future girlfriend/wife or boyfriend/husband, what would you write?
Answer: This was in my draft for long, and I'm feeling shy posting this. Dear future wife, I hope this letter finds you at the moment when you’re smiling, maybe thinking about the dreams and adventures we’ll share. As I write this, I’m a third year engineering student, procrastinating with my work but yeah, I'll do it after writing this post. Btw, do you know what happened today? While I was at the gym, I took a rest between sets and looked out the window. At that very moment, a transformer on the other side of the road caught fire. Earlier today, I was drinking some energy drink, and my mom thought it was beer. I explained it to her and even asked her to taste it, but she didn't like it and scolded me for drinking that. Yesterday, one of my stocks hit a 10% upper circuit, and today my total content views on Quora surpassed 9 million. I also received some dividend from Canara Bank today. And yes, I checked my weight today, and it is now 56 kg, which was 55 kg about three weeks ago. I hope you didn't get bored of that. I love chatting about very random things and I hope you too. If you do, half of our life will be sorted just because of this quality of us. I imagine us meeting in the most unexpected way, perhaps at a college event, classroom, in my company, through some friend or relative or maybe even on Quora itself. haha, this thought makes my day for no reason. As a student, I’m still figuring out my path, but yes, I promise to work hard and strive for a future where we can build a life filled with love, respect, and mutual understanding. I dream of exploring the world together, experiencing different cultures, and creating memories that we’ll cherish forever. I want to travel every country with you, and specially, I want to visit beaches, mountains, waterfalls, villages with you. Your life might be full of challenges and so is mine, I'll say, don't lose hope and work hard. And just think for a second, If life were easy, would it be interesting? And if it isn't intersting, is it worth it? Also, I don't like to spend much money (due to my baniya friends in college who made me like this) but I want you to be as spendthrift as possible. I don't have many expectations and I don't want to impose anything. My only requirement is that whenever I come home stressed after fighting with the world, and I look at you, your cute smile make me forget everything. I don't want much from you, just half of your Maggi masala and bottom of your Ice cream cone🙂. I will give you everything except my Notion and Dropbox passwords (you can get those too after beating me in a game of my choice), my earphones (take my phone, laptop, and everything else but not the earphones), and my Crispello (you can have Silk, KitKat, Roger Federer, or whatever else, but not the Crispello). haha, Just kidding. Even if the fight get intense, we'll just sit and resolve without any loud words and we both will eat in same plate during fights. You'll decide what I'll be wearing when I'm going to your home and vice versa. And we'll have most of the funds in the joint account. I want to do a lot of things, like wanna do long walks holding hands, staring at you till you blushes, doing your makeup untill you look like 🤡, playing with your hairs, sleeping on your lap, going on long drives with your hand on my shoulder, watching movies unless we sleep on sofa, and more stuff, my list is long. And yes, we will respect each other, support each other in every situation, and help each other until our last breath. We'll be each other's rock, facing challenges together and celebrating our victories. Our love will be a sanctuary, a place where we find peace and comfort, no matter what life throws at us. With hope and anticipation, Vansh Yadav ~ Trying to live a life worth remembering (And I hope you too wanna live the same)
